Man Kills Lover in Nagpur, Burns Body Over Marriage Demand

A man allegedly killed his lover in Nagpur after she demanded marriage. The accused reportedly struck the woman on the head and then burned her body using a room heater. Following the incident, the accused fled to Jalgaon by train at night.
